sources.title: GitHub - AngelFireLA/PokemonTCGP-BattleSimulator: Python-based Pokémon ...
sources.snippet: PokemonTCGP-BattleSimulator A Python-based Pokémon TCG Pocket Battle Simulator designed for running automated battle simulations. This tool is ideal for developing and testing AI/bot strategies, analyzing deck performance, and exploring game mechanics with cards from the original TCG extension and promo sets.

sources.title: GitHub - keeshii/ryuu-play: Simulator for the Pokémon Trading Card Game
sources.snippet: RyuuPlay is a simulator for the Pokémon Trading Card Game written in TypeScript. The source code is entirely open source and published under MIT licence. The project is created for the educational purpose only. There is no plans to port all possible cards or provide new features.
